description: A row of marked car bays along an aisle line from start to end (plan mm); the bays lie to the LEFT of start → end seen from above (so start (0,0) → end (24000,0) puts them north of y = 0). As many bays as fit unless count is given. Defaults: 2400 × 5400 bays at 90° (AS/NZS 2890.1 class 1A). angle 30–90° for angled parking. accessible = how many bays at the start of the row are accessible ones, each with a 2400 hatched shared area beside it (AS/NZS 2890.6). startNumber numbers the bays. Allow a 5800 aisle (90°) between facing rows. Plans draw the lines and bay numbers; get_schedule kind parking and project_summary give the bay count.
